source: Source: Tracker.gg, GTA6Database, Vice, Pure Xbox
notes: EXAMPLE 28.11.2026 (user: "1,2 mache mir Beispiele"). CSI gta6 code 528,841 +47.7% (28.11.). Post-launch sources: tracker.gg (26.11.), gta6database (21.11., 13 publishers), game-checklists (24.11.), Vice (19.11.), RPS (18.11.), Pure Xbox (19.11.), gamex (20.11.) all list identical D-pad codes for $250,000, Infinite Ammo, No Reload, Body Armor, Unlimited Focus. $250,000 unlock: "finish the story" (tracker, gta6database, game-checklists, RPS, gamex, gameboost, metaforge); Polygon/RadioTimes/Pure Xbox say "make $250,000 from fenced goods" -> slide only says the cheat list opens after the story. Patch 23.11. left cheats unchanged (gtamap). Challenges count before the story ends (RPS).

tips.title: BEAT THE STORY
tips.body: All 61 cheats open after the main story in Progress › Cheats. Each one has its own challenge, and they count before the ending.

tips.title: OPEN YOUR PHONE
tips.body: Press D-pad Up, hold L1/LB, press R1/RB, then enter the code on the D-pad. Saving and trophies are off for that session.
